items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: I remember I did “Swearin’ to God” with Frankie Valli and I’m playing on “Swearin’ to God.”

ctx.x: Do you recall like thinking oh this is going to be a hit?

Yeah. Not particularly that record but I remember I did “Swearin’ to God” with Frankie Valli and I’m playing on “Swearin’ to God.” That was with a big band. And I felt like that was — something was happening there you know. I really felt like it. Because actually he tracked. He sang with us but he didn’t record. He sang in a booth while we recorded, which was a rehearsal for him also. And I remember it just had a groove happening. And there was a bass player on it, I forget who it was, Elliot Randall was on that.…

that no matter what kind of music it was it felt great man. It could be a polka man. It could be a stupid — he just had a way of playing that you just knew that it was right. Like this guy just knows. And he was just a guy that did gigs around town you know, big black guy, nicest guy in the world. What the hell is his name? Gordon?
